main_argument_chains.claim: WWF is the optimal client for a 5-year wildlife trade reduction project based on MCDM analysis.
support_steps: Construct 12-indicator evaluation system across power, resources, interest, influence
Determine weights via AHP-EWM game-theory combination (CR=0.068)
Rank 8 organizations via TOPSIS composite score
WWF achieves highest score 0.78; theoretical and literature support confirms fit
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: WWF selected as client; project scope and sub-models designed for WWF capabilities.

main_argument_chains.claim: Integrated SIWT model achieves 52.4% trade reduction and 9.3% population increase over 5 years.
support_steps: OPN model reduces purchaser population by 41.2% through publicity strategies
SPW model reduces poaching by 46.64% through enforcement investment
FIWT model predicts trade volume peak at month 30 then decline to 52.4% of original
FWP model projects 9.3% population increase (6.1% under high negative impact)
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Project demonstrates measurable impact; uncertainty analysis confirms robustness.
